title: Attempt By Malefactors To Disable Ships Of Russian Volunteer Fleet

page_data.en:
Shanghai Municipal Police.
（印：…）
CENTRAL POLICE
July 29,
No 2.

REPORT ON Attempt by Malefactors to Disable Ships of
Russian Volunteer Fleet.

Made by D. C. Korolkoff    Forwarded by [签名]

Sir,

Enquiries at the offices of Mr. Goddard, Agent of the
Russian Volunteer Fleet, have elicited the following informa-
tion regarding the attack by armed men from the "Admiral Za-
voiko" on the steamers "Astrakhan" and "Erivan":

About 1.30 p.m. July 25 about 10 men belonging to the
crew of the ship "Admiral Zavoiko" arrived with revolvers and
accompanied by Mr. Y. Rogoff, second engineer of the S.S.
"Astrakhan" ( V.F. ), secretly boarded the S.S. "Erivan" and
tried to force their way into the engine room with a view to
removing some vital part of the machinery in order to render
the vessel incapable of movement. Threatening to shot anyone
attempting to hoist the signal of distress or to leave the ship,
the intruders left two men with revolvers to watch the entrance
of the boatdeck, while the others went down to the engine room.
They were there engaged for about two hours removing important
(parts) fittings from the engines which they intended to take
away. In the meantime some men of the S. S. "Erivan" seeing
that the men left to watch the entrance to the boat-deck had
left their posts, hoisted the signal of distress, whilst the
others armed themselves with crow-bars and stationed themselves
at the deck entrance. When the outlaws were ready to start
loading the parts of the machinery they had taken on board their
launch, the crew of the S.S. "Erivan" headed by Mr. Kolk, first
officer of the S.S. " Erivan" offered resistance. In the mean-
time three men of the crew of the "Erivan" succeeded without
being noticed to secure a Chinese boat and go ashore.

中央捕房
7月29日，
第2号。

关于不法分子企图使俄国志愿舰队船只瘫痪的报告。

由 D. C. Korolkoff 撰写    由 [签名] 转呈

先生：

经向俄国志愿舰队代理高达德（Goddard）先生办事处查询，获悉有关武装人员从“扎沃伊科海军上将”号（Admiral Zavoiko）袭击“阿斯特拉罕”号（Astrakhan）和“埃里温”号（Erivan）轮船的下列情况：

7月25日下午约1时30分，属于“扎沃伊科海军上将”号船员的大约10人携带左轮手枪，在“阿斯特拉罕”号轮船（V.F.）的二副 Y. Rogoff 先生陪同下，秘密登上“埃里温”号轮船，并试图强行进入机舱，意图拆除机器的某些关键部件，致使该船无法移动。入侵者威胁称，任何试图升起求救信号或离开船只的人都将遭到枪击，他们留下两名持左轮手枪的人看守艇甲板入口，其余人则下至机舱。他们在那里花了大约两个小时，拆卸打算带走的发动机重要（部件）配件。在此期间，“埃里温”号轮船的一些船员看到留守看守艇甲板入口的人离开了岗位，便升起了求救信号，而其他人则拿起撬棍，驻守在甲板入口处。当不法之徒准备开始将他们拆下的机器部件装载到他们的汽艇上时，“埃里温”号轮船的船员在该船大副 Kolk 先生的带领下进行了抵抗。与此同时，“埃里温”号船员的三人成功地在未被察觉的情况下弄到一艘中国小船并上岸。

Seeing this move and noticing that the signal had been hois-
ted, the outlaws from the "Admiral Zavoiko" speedily got on
board their launch and went away leaving the machinery parts
behind.
from the "Admiral Zavoiko"
Another party visited the S. S. "Astrakhan" the same
day. One of them read a message from the captain of "Admiral
Zavoiko" to the master of "Astrakhan" requesting the latter t
deliver some parts of the ship's machinery. This party was
not allowed to board the "Astrakhan". The message mentioned
was substantially as follows: "To the master of the S.S.
"Astrakhan". I have received information that malefactors
intend to seize your ship. Being the officer commanding a
man-of-war and obliged to protect the merchant ship, and acting
in accordance with the instructions given to me, I hereby re-
quest you to deliver immediately some parts of the machinery of
your ship to me. In case you need to move to another place,
the above parts will be returned at once" Signed Klus, commander
of the ship "Admiral Zavoiko", P. Orlovsky, Commissary. Starter
(the signature illegible).

According to the information got from Mr. Collins, assis-
tant agent of the V. F, the news published by the "China Press"
that the S. S. "Astrakhan" and "Erivan" took coal in order to
leave Shanghai secretly are absolutely untrue being only an
invention of the Bolsheviks and used by them as a pretext
for damaging the Russian Volunteer Fleet ships. It is true

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

中央捕房

报告

- 2 -

“扎沃伊科海军上将”号的不法之徒看到这一举动并注意到已升起求救信号，迅速登上他们的汽艇离去，将机器部件留在原地。
来自“扎沃伊科海军上将”号
另一伙人于同日访问了“阿斯特拉罕”号轮船。其中一人向“阿斯特拉罕”号船长宣读了“扎沃伊科海军上将”号船长的一封信，要求后者交付该船的部分机器部件。这伙人未被允许登上“阿斯特拉罕”号。所提及的信件大意如下：“致‘阿斯特拉罕’号轮船船长。我收到情报，不法分子意图劫持贵船。身为军舰指挥官，我有义务保护商船，并根据所获指示行事，特此要求你立即向我交付贵船的部分机器部件。如需移往他处，上述部件将立即归还。”签署人：“扎沃伊科海军上将”号指挥官 Klus，委员 P. Orlovsky。司炉（签名不清）。

据俄国志愿舰队助理代理柯林斯（Collins）先生提供的信息，《字林西报》（China Press）刊登的关于“阿斯特拉罕”号和“埃里温”号为秘密离开上海而加装煤炭的消息纯属虚构，这仅是布尔什维克的捏造，并被他们用作损坏俄国志愿舰队船只的借口。确实

that the ships took about 5 tons of coal each in order to
raise steam to move to another anchorage in compliance with
a request of the Harbour-master as the part of the fairway
where they are lying is to be cleaned before the typhoons
start. The ships had no intention to defy the order of the
Mixed Court.

A document regarding the invasion of the ships by the
Bolsheviks has been written and signed by the officers and
the crews of the two ships, and a protest in connection with
the affair has been made to the Commissioner for Foreign
Affairs and the Bureau for Russian Affairs.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
B. Y. Korolcoff
D. C.

两船确实各加装了约5吨煤炭，以便产生蒸汽移至另一锚地，这是应港务长的要求，因为它们停泊的航道部分需在台风来临前进行清理。这些船只并无意违抗混合法庭的命令。

一份关于布尔什维克入侵船只的文件已由两船的官员和船员撰写并签署，并就此事向外事专员及俄事局提出了抗议。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，
B. Y. Korolcoff
D. C.
